# appdynamics_groups (Data Source)

Lists the RBAC groups in the current AppDynamics account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "appdynamics_groups" "all" {}

output "group_names" {
  value = { for g in data.appdynamics_groups.all.groups : g.id => g.name }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `groups` (Attributes List) The groups in the account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--groups))
